text.content:
name: cross-backend-minimal
version: 1.0.0
description: Smallest scenario that resolves inside more than one provisioning backend's
  realization envelope, for use as the shared input to cross-backend parity checks.
  Compute intent is authored without a virtualization mechanism or an operating system,
  so each backend selects a compatible substrate instead of contradicting an authored
  value.
nodes:
  lab:
    type: switch
  workload:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
infrastructure:
  lab:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.10.0.0/24
      gateway: 10.10.0.1
      internal: true
  workload:
    count: 1
    links:
    - lab
